flammable_liquids.quote: TABLE Column 1 Column 2 Item Category Criteria 1 Flammable Liquids — Category 1 A liquid that has a flash point < 23°C and initial boiling point ≤ 35°C 2 Flammable Liquids — Category 2 A liquid that has a flash point < 23°C and initial boiling point > 35°C 3 Flammable Liquids — Category 3 A liquid that has a flash point ≥ 23°C and ≤ 60°C 4 Flammable Liquids — Category 4 A liquid that has a flash point > 60°C and ≤ 93°C
